title: FLA import: CPicMorphShape end-geometry silently skipped in shape tweens
description: In flash8-binary.ts, skipMorphData discards CPicMorphShape end-shape geometry entirely. Shape tweens imported from real FLA files tween from start shape to nothing. Decode CMorphSegment/CMorphCurve children into the end-keyframe display object for correct round-tripped FLA shape tween rendering.
